notes: Only lib/default is in scope; the other templates under lib/ are not.
Route classes are created in lib/default/src/server.ts:8 and mounted in a loop at / (lib/default/src/app.ts:56-59).
UserRoute builds its paths from the class constant path = '/users' (lib/default/src/routes/users.route.ts:8); AuthRoute has no prefix.
Paths are the strings Express receives: `${this.path}/:id(\\d+)` in source becomes /users/:id(\d+).
Not listed: app.use('/api-docs', swaggerUi.serve, ...) at lib/default/src/app.ts:75 mounts Swagger UI middleware, not a method route.
Not routes: src/http/*.http request samples and src/tests/*.
